mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 days, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 6% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If unemployment exceeds 6% but S&P 500 returns remain positive, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When employment increases but unemployment also rises, it indicates conflicting labor market signals, causing market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both employment and unemployment rise but returns are positive, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in federal funds rate below 2% indicates monetary easing, boosting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is below 2% but returns do not exceed baseline, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts reflects strong demand, positively impacting the economy and leading to higher S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts rise but returns are negative, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 2% indicates strong supply activity, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth exceeds 2% but returns do not improve, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate combined with high retail sales growth indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but returns are not positive, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: High CPI inflation above 190 indicates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If CPI exceeds 190 but returns are positive, this hypothesis is rejected.
